fact.en:
What is current electricity?

It is the continuous flow of electrons through a complete circuit, like water moving through a closed hose!
fact.tl:
Ano ang current electricity?

Ito ang tuloy-tuloy na pagdaloy ng mga electron sa isang kumpletong circuit, parang tubig na dumadaloy sa saradong hose!
fact.bis:
Unsa ang current electricity?

Kini ang padayon nga pag-agos sa mga electron sa usa ka kompleto nga circuit, sama sa tubig nga nag-agos sa sirado nga hose!

cards.illustration: A glowing bulb connected by wires to a dry cell, with small arrows showing electrons moving around the closed loop.

fact.en: An electric circuit is a closed loop that gives electric current a complete return path from the source, through the load, and back again.
fact.tl: Ang electric circuit ay isang saradong loop na nagbibigay sa electric current ng kumpletong daanan pabalik mula sa source, papunta sa load, at pabalik muli.
fact.bis: Ang electric circuit usa ka sirado nga loop nga naghatag sa electric current ug kompleto nga agianan pabalik sugod sa source, paingon sa load, ug balik pag-usab.

cards.illustration: A simple closed loop made of wire connecting a battery to a small bulb, with the bulb glowing.

fact.en: The main parts of an electric circuit are the conductor, the source, and the load, and each one has its own job.
fact.tl: Ang pangunahing bahagi ng electric circuit ay ang conductor, source, at load, at bawat isa ay may sariling trabaho.
fact.bis: Ang pangunahing mga parte sa electric circuit mao ang conductor, source, ug load, ug ang matag usa adunay kaugalingong trabaho.

cards.illustration: A labeled diagram showing a battery as the source, wires as the conductor, and a bulb as the load in one simple circuit.

fact.en:
What does a conductor do in a circuit?

A conductor, like a copper wire, is the pathway that lets electric current travel from the source to the other parts!
fact.tl:
Ano ang ginagawa ng conductor sa isang circuit?

Ang conductor, tulad ng copper wire, ang nagsisilbing daanan para makapaglakbay ang electric current mula sa source papunta sa ibang bahagi!
fact.bis:
Unsa ang gibuhat sa conductor sa usa ka circuit?

Ang conductor, sama sa copper wire, mao ang agianan nga nagpalakaw sa electric current sugod sa source paingon sa uban pang mga parte!

cards.illustration: A copper wire connecting a dry cell to a bulb, with the wire shown as a clear path for current.

fact.en: The source, such as a dry cell or battery, is the part of the circuit that supplies the electrical energy needed to move the current.
fact.tl: Ang source, tulad ng dry cell o battery, ang bahagi ng circuit na nagsusuplay ng electrical energy na kailangan para gumalaw ang current.
fact.bis: Ang source, sama sa dry cell o battery, mao ang parte sa circuit nga nagsuplay ug electrical energy nga gikinahanglan aron molihok ang current.

cards.illustration: A dry cell battery standing beside a glowing bulb, with wires connecting them to show the battery giving energy.

fact.en:
Why is a bulb called the load in a circuit?

Because the bulb is the part that uses the electrical energy, and it also shows whether the circuit is complete!
fact.tl:
Bakit tinatawag na load ang bulb sa isang circuit?

Dahil ang bulb ang bahaging gumagamit ng electrical energy, at ipinapakita rin nito kung kumpleto ang circuit!
fact.bis:
Ngano gitawag nga load ang bulb sa usa ka circuit?

Tungod kay ang bulb mao ang parte nga mogamit sa electrical energy, ug gipakita usab niini kung kompleto ba ang circuit!

cards.illustration: A glowing bulb in a simple circuit, with the light showing that the circuit is complete and working.

fact.en: A series circuit allows electric current to flow through only one single path, so all the loads share the same pathway.
fact.tl: Ang series circuit ay nagpapadaloy ng electric current sa iisang daanan lamang, kaya lahat ng load ay nagbabahagi sa parehong pathway.
fact.bis: Ang series circuit nagpaagos sa electric current sa usa lamang ka agianan, busa ang tanang load mag-ambit sa parehong pathway.

cards.illustration: Three bulbs connected one after another in a single loop of wire with one battery.

fact.en:
Why do all the bulbs go out in a series circuit when one bulb is loose?

Because the single path is broken, so the circuit opens and current cannot flow to any bulb!
fact.tl:
Bakit namamatay ang lahat ng bulb sa series circuit kapag maluwag ang isang bulb?

Dahil naputol ang nag-iisang daanan, kaya bumukas ang circuit at hindi na makadaloy ang current sa kahit anong bulb!
fact.bis:
Ngano mangamatay ang tanang bulb sa series circuit kung ang usa ka bulb luag?

Tungod kay naputol ang bugtong agianan, busa naabli ang circuit ug dili na makaagos ang current sa bisan unsang bulb!

cards.illustration: Three bulbs in a row, with one bulb removed from its socket and the other two bulbs dark.

fact.en: Adding more bulbs or resistance in a series circuit decreases the current, so the bulbs become dimmer because the source has more work to do.
fact.tl: Kapag dinagdagan ng bulbs o resistance sa series circuit, bumababa ang current, kaya humihina ang liwanag ng mga bulb dahil mas maraming trabaho ang source.
fact.bis: Kung dugangan ug bulbs o resistance sa series circuit, momenos ang current, busa modulom ang mga bulb tungod kay mas daghan ang trabaho sa source.

cards.illustration: A series circuit with one bright bulb beside a series circuit with three dimmer bulbs connected to the same battery.

fact.en: Adding more dry cells in series can increase the voltage, which is the push that moves electric charges through the circuit.
fact.tl: Ang pagdaragdag ng dry cells na naka-series ay nakakapagpataas ng voltage, na siyang tulak na nagpapagalaw sa mga electric charge sa circuit.
fact.bis: Ang pagdugang ug mga dry cell nga naka-series makapataas sa voltage, nga mao ang tulak nga nagpalihok sa mga electric charge sa circuit.

cards.illustration: Two dry cells connected end to end in a series circuit with a brightly glowing bulb.

fact.en: Series circuits need fewer wiring connections, but they have only one pathway for current, so every part must work for the circuit to work.
fact.tl: Ang series circuit ay nangangailangan ng mas kaunting wiring connections, pero iisa lang ang daanan ng current, kaya dapat gumana ang bawat bahagi para gumana ang circuit.
fact.bis: Ang series circuit nagkinahanglan ug mas diyutay nga wiring connections, apan usa ra ang agianan sa current, busa kinahanglang molihok ang matag parte aron molihok ang circuit.

cards.illustration: A simple series circuit with only a few wires connecting one battery to two bulbs in a single loop.

fact.en:
What makes a parallel circuit different from a series circuit?

A parallel circuit has two or more paths for electric current, so each load has its own branch!
fact.tl:
Ano ang pinagkaiba ng parallel circuit sa series circuit?

Ang parallel circuit ay may dalawa o higit pang daanan para sa electric current, kaya bawat load ay may sariling branch!
fact.bis:
Unsa ang kalainan sa parallel circuit ug series circuit?

Ang parallel circuit adunay duha o daghan pa nga agianan alang sa electric current, busa ang matag load adunay kaugalingong branch!

cards.illustration: Three bulbs each connected on their own separate wire branch from the same battery.

fact.en: In a parallel circuit, appliances operate independently, so if one bulb burns out, the other bulbs continue to glow.
fact.tl: Sa parallel circuit, ang mga appliances ay gumagana nang hiwalay, kaya kapag pumutok ang isang bulb, patuloy pa ring sisindi ang ibang bulbs.
fact.bis: Sa parallel circuit, ang mga appliances molihok nga independente, busa kung maputol ang usa ka bulb, ang uban pang mga bulb magpadayon sa pagsiga.

cards.illustration: Three bulbs in a parallel circuit, with one bulb dark and removed while the other two still glow brightly.

fact.en: Parallel circuits have many wiring connections because each load gets its own branch from the source.
fact.tl: Maraming wiring connections ang parallel circuit dahil bawat load ay may sariling branch mula sa source.
fact.bis: Daghan ug wiring connections ang parallel circuit tungod kay ang matag load adunay kaugalingong branch nga naggikan sa source.

cards.illustration: A parallel circuit with many wires branching out from a battery to three separate bulbs.

fact.en:
Does adding more bulbs in a parallel circuit make them dimmer?

No! The voltage stays the same in each branch, so the bulbs keep their brightness.
fact.tl:
Kapag dinagdagan ng bulbs sa parallel circuit, hihina ba ang liwanag ng mga ito?

Hindi! Nananatiling pareho ang voltage sa bawat branch, kaya hindi humihina ang liwanag ng mga bulb.
fact.bis:
Kung dugangan ug bulbs sa parallel circuit, modulom ba ang mga kini?

Dili! Magpabilin nga pareho ang voltage sa matag branch, busa dili modulom ang mga bulb.

cards.illustration: Three equally bright bulbs in a parallel circuit connected to one battery.

fact.en: In a parallel connection using dry cells, all positive terminals are connected together and all negative terminals are connected together.
fact.tl: Sa parallel connection gamit ang dry cells, lahat ng positive terminals ay magkakadugtong at lahat ng negative terminals ay magkakadugtong din.
fact.bis: Sa parallel connection nga naggamit ug dry cells, ang tanang positive terminals konektado ug ang tanang negative terminals konektado usab.

cards.illustration: Two dry cells side by side with their positive terminals joined by one wire and negative terminals joined by another wire.

fact.en: When dry cells are connected in parallel, the total voltage of the circuit is the same as the voltage of a single dry cell.
fact.tl: Kapag ang mga dry cell ay naka-parallel, ang total voltage ng circuit ay kapareho ng voltage ng isang dry cell lamang.
fact.bis: Kung ang mga dry cell naka-parallel, ang total voltage sa circuit pareho ra sa voltage sa usa ka dry cell lamang.

cards.illustration: Two dry cells connected in parallel to a bulb, with a label showing the voltage stays the same as one cell.

fact.en:
What happens to the total current when you add more bulbs in a parallel circuit?

The total current increases because the source must supply more branches, even though the overall resistance decreases!
fact.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa total current kapag dinagdagan ng bulbs sa parallel circuit?

Tumataas ang total current dahil kailangang suplayan ng source ang mas maraming branch, kahit bumababa ang overall resistance!
fact.bis:
Unsa ang mahitabo sa total current kung dugangan ug bulbs sa parallel circuit?

Motubo ang total current tungod kay kinahanglang suplayan sa source ang mas daghan nga branch, bisan pa momenos ang overall resistance!

cards.illustration: A parallel circuit with one bulb, then beside it a parallel circuit with three bulbs, with arrows showing more total current in the second.

fact.en: Home lightings are wired in parallel so that lamps, electric fans, and other appliances can be controlled individually.
fact.tl: Ang mga ilaw sa bahay ay naka-wire nang parallel para ang mga lampara, electric fan, at iba pang appliances ay kayang kontrolin nang isa-isa.
fact.bis: Ang mga suga sa balay naka-wire nga parallel aron ang mga lampara, electric fan, ug uban pang appliances makontrol nga tagsa-tagsa.

cards.illustration: A house with different rooms, each with its own light switch and bulb connected to the same main power line.

fact.en: One advantage of a series circuit is that more dry cells can be added to increase the voltage, giving a stronger push to the current.
fact.tl: Isang bentahe ng series circuit ay maaaring dagdagan ang dry cells para tumaas ang voltage, na nagbibigay ng mas malakas na tulak sa current.
fact.bis: Usa ka bentaha sa series circuit mao nga makadugang ug mga dry cell aron motaas ang voltage, nga maghatag ug mas kusog nga tulak sa current.

cards.illustration: A series circuit with two dry cells connected end to end, making a bulb glow brighter than with one cell.

fact.en:
Why are series circuits not used for home lighting?

Because when one bulb burns out, the single path opens and all the other bulbs stop working!
fact.tl:
Bakit hindi ginagamit ang series circuit para sa ilaw sa bahay?

Dahil kapag pumutok ang isang bulb, mabubuksan ang nag-iisang daanan at hihinto ang lahat ng iba pang bulb!
fact.bis:
Ngano dili gamiton ang series circuit alang sa suga sa balay?

Tungod kay kung maputol ang usa ka bulb, maabli ang bugtong agianan ug mang-undang ang tanang uban pang bulb!

cards.illustration: A string of old-style Christmas lights in series, with one bulb removed and the whole string dark.

fact.en: A parallel circuit has two or more pathways for electric current, so when one bulb burns out, the other bulbs continue to glow.
fact.tl: Ang parallel circuit ay may dalawa o higit pang daanan para sa electric current, kaya kapag pumutok ang isang bulb, patuloy pa ring sisindi ang iba.
fact.bis: Ang parallel circuit adunay duha o daghan pa nga agianan alang sa electric current, busa kung maputol ang usa ka bulb, ang uban magpadayon sa pagsiga.

cards.illustration: Three bulbs in parallel, with one bulb dark and removed while the other two remain bright.

fact.en: The main disadvantage of a parallel circuit is that it requires many wiring connections because each load has its own branch.
fact.tl: Ang pangunahing disbentahe ng parallel circuit ay nangangailangan ito ng maraming wiring connections dahil bawat load ay may sariling branch.
fact.bis: Ang pangunang disbentahe sa parallel circuit mao nga nagkinahanglan kini ug daghan nga wiring connections tungod kay ang matag load adunay kaugalingong branch.

cards.illustration: A parallel circuit with many wires branching out from a battery to three separate bulbs, showing the complex wiring.

fact.en: In a series circuit, the electric current that passes through each bulb is the same because there is only one path for the electrons to follow.
fact.tl: Sa series circuit, ang electric current na dumadaan sa bawat bulb ay pareho dahil iisa lang ang daanan ng mga electron.
fact.bis: Sa series circuit, ang electric current nga moagi sa matag bulb pareho ra tungod kay usa ra ang agianan sa mga electron.

cards.illustration: Three bulbs in a series circuit with arrows showing the same amount of current flowing through each bulb.

fact.en:
Is the voltage different in each branch of a parallel circuit?

No! The voltage remains the same at all points in a parallel circuit when the source is constant.
fact.tl:
Magkaiba ba ang voltage sa bawat branch ng parallel circuit?

Hindi! Nananatiling pareho ang voltage sa lahat ng punto ng parallel circuit kapag pareho ang source.
fact.bis:
Lahi-lahi ba ang voltage sa matag branch sa parallel circuit?

Dili! Magpabilin nga pareho ang voltage sa tanang punto sa parallel circuit kung pareho ang source.

cards.illustration: A parallel circuit with three bulbs, each branch showing the same voltage reading from the same battery.

fact.en: For the devices in a series circuit to work, each device must work, because the current has only one complete path to follow.
fact.tl: Para gumana ang mga device sa series circuit, dapat gumana ang bawat device, dahil iisa lang ang kumpletong daanan ng current.
fact.bis: Aron molihok ang mga device sa series circuit, kinahanglang molihok ang matag device, tungod kay usa ra ang kompleto nga agianan sa current.

cards.illustration: A series circuit with three bulbs, all glowing, showing that every bulb must work for the circuit to function.

fact.en: In a parallel circuit, electrical devices are connected in a branched manner, making each one independent from all other connections.
fact.tl: Sa parallel circuit, ang mga electrical device ay nakakonekta nang branched, kaya ang bawat isa ay hiwalay sa lahat ng iba pang koneksyon.
fact.bis: Sa parallel circuit, ang mga electrical device konektado nga branched, busa ang matag usa independente sa tanang uban pang koneksyon.

cards.illustration: A parallel circuit with three bulbs, each on its own separate branch from the main wires.

fact.en:
What happens if you remove one bulb from a three-bulb parallel circuit?

The circuit simply becomes a two-bulb parallel circuit, and the other bulbs stay lit!
fact.tl:
Ano ang mangyayari kapag tinanggal ang isang bulb sa three-bulb parallel circuit?

Ang circuit ay magiging two-bulb parallel circuit na lamang, at mananatiling nakasindi ang ibang bulbs!
fact.bis:
Unsa ang mahitabo kung tangtangon ang usa ka bulb sa three-bulb parallel circuit?

Ang circuit mahimo na lamang nga two-bulb parallel circuit, ug magpabilin nga nagasiga ang uban pang mga bulb!

cards.illustration: A three-bulb parallel circuit with one bulb being removed, while the other two bulbs continue to glow.
